name: users_v2
description: Modernized user table for the new microservices platform

fields.name: id
fields.description: User identifier carried over from legacy system

fields.name: first_name
fields.description: User first name extracted from full_name

fields.name: last_name
fields.description: User last name extracted from full_name

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Account creation timestamp in ISO 8601 format

fields.name: status
fields.description: Account status (deleted users are excluded from migration)

fields.name: total_logins
fields.description: Total login count as proper integer

fields.name: last_active_at
fields.description: Last activity timestamp in ISO 8601 format

fields.name: profile_summary
fields.description: Truncated user bio for the new compact profile

fields.name: department
fields.description: Full department name resolved from department_code
